text.content:
The merc bar, in an old morgue. Rogue's house.

Region: Little China, Watson (#1)
Controlled by: Rogue Amendiares
The feel of it: Legends on the walls; drinks named after the dead
Notable locations: Rogue's table in the back
Danger: SC 8: Afterlife security, very hard and very private. Nobody has ever started a fight inside twice

Night City's most famous edgerunner bar, in an old morgue, owned by the Queen of the Afterlife. Its drinks are named after edgerunners who went out in a blaze of glory. The Afterlife doesn't take members, only contracts, and never takes sides in corporate or gang wars.

Getting In

For a Night City merc, setting foot inside is a huge threshold. The bouncer decides who walks in. A name that means something on the street will do it, and so will someone already inside vouching for you. If you embarrass whoever vouched, Rogue remembers them, and remembers you longer.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.21; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 04, 08
